item: R767: the local AI accepts loopback literals and exactly localhost; host-file aliases are refused naming the literal, and localhost's answer is checked loopback on the socket
key_paths: src/llm/loopback.py; src/ingest/loopback_scope.py; src/ingest/airplane.py; src/llm/ollama.py; src/llm/vllm_client.py; src/llm/vllm_lifecycle.py; src/static/app-ai-tools.js; tests/test_loopback_rule_r767.py
summary: Release note: the local AI (Ollama, vLLM) now refuses the addresses ip6-localhost, ip6-loopback and localhost.localdomain, which are on this computer only if its hosts file says so, and says which address to use instead (127.0.0.1 or [::1]); and when the address is localhost, every address that name resolves to is checked to be on this computer before anything connects, so a resolver that answers localhost with another machine can no longer send your prompts there.
